INSERT INTO "DocumentInstance" ("documentId", sha, "createdAt", "updatedAt")
        SELECT $1, $2, next.stamp, next.stamp
        FROM (
            SELECT GREATEST(
                LOCALTIMESTAMP(3),
                (SELECT max("createdAt") FROM "DocumentInstance" WHERE "documentId" = $1)
                    + interval '1 millisecond'
            ) AS stamp
        ) AS next
        RETURNING id
